At Ben Line, our Great People are the key to our success.

We employ more than 2000 people across Asia Pacific and beyond

We are constantly looking to develop our existing people to maximise their potential, and to recruit new talent that will enable business growth, process improvement and enhanced service quality.

Health, Safety, Environment & Quality

We are committed to our HSEQ policies to protect and guide our people, partners and customers.

Learn More

Compliance

At Ben Line we are committed to implement our compliance policies and processes that guide us in all activity across the network.

Training programs, review and revision of process, engagement with stakeholders are part of this ongoing process
